# Priscilla Grant

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Family:** [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with a fair and golden appearance. When dressed up, she wears silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student. Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, she is also full of fun, mischief, and pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), where the two became friends during their student days. She joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) for a spring picnic walk, during which they named [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), discovered Hester Gray's forgotten garden, and shared poetic thoughts on nature by a brook. Later, Priscilla unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) accompanying Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed a close friendship while studying together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Their bond continues through shared outings, such as exploring woodland paths and discovering Hester Gray's garden alongside other friends, where they bond over poetic reflections on nature. Priscilla also visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), notably arriving with guest Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is recovering from a cosmetic mishap.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +19 more_

- Friend of — intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +5 more</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is Priscilla's aunt. Priscilla accompanies her and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) on an unexpected visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to dine and walk in the woods with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), +4 more_
